1.

Say, was it the Righteous One, God’s own beloved Son, Who, that He might show us God’s grace, Came down from heaven’s throne?

2.

Yes, Jesus came and for our sake In death gave Himself up. We shall not now come into judgment, Our judgment He took upon Himself.

3.

Our sin He bore, our guilt He took, Such was God’s counsel of love. Our punishment He suffered, our death He died, O, wonder of grace!

4.

O, teach us better to thank Thee, More praise and worship to give For all the riches of that love We see in the word.
